examples.question_fa: برای آخرین سال جهانی combined burden افسردگی، اضطراب و bipolar رو بساز.
examples.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT country_name, disorder, prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)), p AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN disorder='depression' THEN prevalence_pct END) AS dep, MAX(CASE WHEN disorder='anxiety' THEN prevalence_pct END) AS anx, MAX(CASE WHEN disorder='bipolar' THEN prevalence_pct END) AS bip FROM latest GROUP BY country_name) SELECT country_name, ROUND(dep,4) AS depression_pct, ROUND(anx,4) AS anxiety_pct, ROUND(bip,4) AS bipolar_pct, ROUND(dep+anx+bip,4) AS combined_burden_score FROM p WHERE dep IS NOT NULL AND anx IS NOT NULL AND bip IS NOT NULL ORDER BY combined_burden_score DESC LIMIT 20;
